purpose: New front-facing Bloom, Drop and Twig concepts matching the owner's selected new Sprig
prompt:
Create a beautiful NEW CHARACTER LINEUP for the Bloomlings mobile garden game: three equally adorable full-body characters BLOOM, DROP and TWIG, side by side, facing straight forward, on a plain warm ivory studio background with soft subtle floor shadows. Wide landscape composition, generous empty space between characters and margins around every petal, hand and foot. These are the remaining three friends to match the NEW SPRIG in REFERENCE IMAGE 1. Image 1 is the PRIMARY STYLE AND PROPORTIONS REFERENCE, not a character to include in the output. Images 2,3,4 identify the older Bloom, Drop, Twig designs; reimagine them with the much cuter, more compact, premium sculpted quality of image 1. Do not merely copy the older stiff models.

Common art direction: enormous expressive heads, tiny plump bodies, almost no neck, extremely short legs and softly rounded feet. Warm huge glossy dark eyes with small clear catchlights, tiny simple eyebrows, subtle peach-pink blush, joyful open smiles with little tongues INSIDE mouths, no outlined lips or makeup. Lovely soft satin sculpted materials, luminous gentle studio lighting, clean broad shapes, premium charming 3D animated garden mascot aesthetic. Rich but gentle color gradients, well defined shapes, no gritty textures, no flat cheap plastic. Each character has two short arms held slightly outwards with open palms, exactly FOUR DIGITS per hand: THREE short round fingers plus ONE thumb. Neat simple consistent hands, no tangled fingers. Heads upright, eyes level looking directly at viewer. Same overall character height and same shared design language. The vibe is sweet, lively and huggable like Sprig, not realistic and not generic human babies.

LEFT: BLOOM, a little pink flower spirit. A large soft rounded-square warm pale blush-pink face, huge warm dark brown eyes with at most one tiny outer eyelash each, tiny pale pink button nose, open happy smile. Eight broad thick gently curved rose-pink petals fan around the back of the head, creating a clear flower silhouette with overlapping sculpted layers, a few subtle broad petal folds, luminous pink edges, deeper soft pink at bases, no noisy veins or sharp spiky petals. Tiny cream-and-golden five-petal blossom at the center above the forehead. Tiny plump peach-pink body, small layered petal collar and rounded pink petal chest piece, little pink feet. Beautifully soft, cheerful and playful; no makeup, no princess dress, no jewelry, no green Sprig leaf hair.

CENTER: DROP, a lovable little water spirit. Huge rounded turquoise-blue water-drop-shaped HEAD with a single elegant slightly curved tip rising above it, full round cheeks and pale aqua central face area. The head is the dominant silhouette, with a TINY separate plump blue torso under it, short arms, tiny stubby legs and round blue feet. Expressive huge deep navy-blue eyes, blue eyebrows, faint rosy cheeks, tiny happy open smile. Smooth opaque aqua satin body with a few controlled pearly highlights, a softer lighter face and deeper blue feet. Stylized water character, not transparent glass, not wet realistic slime. No clothes, no crown, no bubbles or floating particles or props.

RIGHT: TWIG, a tiny acorn wood spirit. Oversized softly rounded-square honey-gold face, enormous warm dark brown eyes, tiny rounded nose, joyful smile and peach cheeks. A chunky chestnut-brown acorn cap sits low around the upper head, with a thick gently segmented rounded rim and a few large simple overlapping cap panels. A short rounded twig stem on top and ONE small bright green leaf leaning to one side. Tiny plump honey-amber body with a simple pale golden leaf-shaped chest panel; stubby warm brown limbs with four-digit rounded hands and little brown feet. Only a few broad stylized wood grooves, no cracked bark, no realistic wood grain, no scary twig fingers. Warm, cozy and mischievous, cute as Sprig.

Only these THREE characters in the image, not Sprig. Small clean gray names BLOOM, DROP, TWIG centered below them. No other text, no UI, no landscape, no pedestal, no contact sheet of multiple angles. Render full figures with consistent front-facing framing and equal visual prominence.
